data.name: Rukn
data.gender_notes: Rukn is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rukn is an Arabic name that symbolizes strength and support. In Islamic tradition, it refers to the pillars of faith and the five daily prayers. The name Rukn carries the meaning “Pillar of Strength” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rukn usually hope their child will grow to embody pillar of strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Rukn is mentioned as one of the pillars of faith, emphasizing the importance of a strong foundation in one's beliefs.
data.etymology: Rukn belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pillar of Strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rukn total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: ركن
in_arabic.meaning: ركن تعمیر کی بنیاد، مضبوط ستون، اسلام کا ایک اہم جزو
in_arabic.long_meaning: ركن عربي زبان کا ایک لفظ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے تعمیر کی بنیاد، مضبوط ستون یا اہم جزو۔ اسلامی علماء کے نزدیک ركن سے مراد وہ بنیادی اصول یا عقیدہ ہے جو اسلامی عقیدے کی بنیاد بناتا ہے۔ قرآن مجید میں ركن کی اصطلاح مختلف سیاقات میں استعمال ہوئی ہے، لیکن عموماً یہ لفظ مضبوطی، پائیداری اور اہم ہونے کی علامت ہے۔

in_urdu.name: رکن
in_urdu.meaning: تعمیر کی بنیاد، مضبوط ستون، اسلام کا ایک اہم جزو، بنیادی اصول
in_urdu.long_meaning: رکن اردو زبان میں عربی لفظ ركن کا ترجمہ ہے، جو تعمیر کی بنیاد، مضبوط ستون یا بنیادی اصول کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں رکن سے مراد وہ اہم عناصر ہیں جو اسلامی عقیدے اور عمل کی بنیاد بناتے ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان، رکن نام اچھی قسمت، مضبوطی اور روحانی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रुक्न
in_hindi.meaning: निर्माण की नींव, मजबूत स्तंभ, इस्लाम का एक महत्वपूर्ण अंग
in_hindi.long_meaning: रुक्न हिंदी में एक महत्वपूर्ण इस्लामी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है निर्माण की नींव, मजबूत स्तंभ या इस्लाम का एक महत्वपूर्ण अंग। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में अच्छे भाग्य, ताकत और आध्यात्मिक महत्व का प्रतीक है। रुक्न की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है और इसका उपयोग इस्लामी परंपरा में एक मूलभूत सिद्धांत या तत्व को दर्शाने के लिए किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: رکن
in_pashto.meaning: د جوړښت بنسټ، قوي ستون، د اسلام يو مهم جز
in_pashto.long_meaning: رکن د پښتو ژبې يو مهم نوم دی چې د جوړښت بنسټ، قوي ستون یا د اسلام يو مهم جز معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې د نیکمرغۍ، پیاوړتیا او روحاني ارزښتونو د سمبول په توګه کارول کیږي. رکن د عربي ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او په اسلامي علم او تاريخ کې د يو مهم رکن يا بنسټ د مفهوم په توګه کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Rukn
in_english.meaning: A fundamental element, a strong pillar, or a cornerstone
in_english.long_meaning: Rukn is an Arabic name that signifies a fundamental element, a strong pillar, or a cornerstone. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'r-k-n', it connotes strength, stability, and essentiality. In Islamic tradition, Rukn refers to the basic principles or components that form the foundation of faith or a structure. Historically, the term has been used in various contexts, including the pillars of Islam. The name Rukn symbolizes spiritual strength, reliability, and the importance of foundational values in Muslim cultures worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the term Rukn is commonly used to refer to a person who plays a significant role in someone's life, providing emotional, moral, or practical support. They act as a source of strength, security, and guidance. Moreover, Rukn is one of the names of Allah, which emphasizes His role as the Unshakeable, the Everlasting, and the Source of All Strength.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, Rukn is described as the pillars of Islam. The Five Pillars of Islam – Shahada (belief), Salat (prayer), Zakat (giving), Sawm (fasting), and Hajj (pilgrimage) – collectively known as the Rukn-e-din (pillars of faith). These practices serve as the foundation for a person's spiritual growth and draw them closer to Allah. By following these principles and maintaining a strong connection with Allah, Muslims can build a balanced and resilient spiritually and morally, leaning on their Creator for unwavering support and guidance.
